purpose: S2 experiment, fine pass: the coarse sweep left only full-06 cells within +-100 ms of the retained reference alive, agreement rose monotonically with uniform press lag (+0 ms -> 14/42, +60 -> 15, +81.6 -> 18, +100 -> 26) and the retained landing latency is 81.6 ms (p10 52.3, p90 99.8), so the press-acceptance lag is mapped at 10 ms resolution over [-200, +150] ms at rate 0. Uniform timer rate is not repeated: every coarse rate cell died or disagreed, and the night-length integral (full-06: phone 6 AM 420.2 s after origin vs the model's 420.0 s) already bounds any accumulated-timer error, constant or varying, below ~1 s over the night.
modelOptionsNote: the options the retained control result ran under (its method.modelOptionsSha256 b7eddb6025147181a8f837ed15e013925809c03d37d9f9b8aa358984daad44a4)

control.rule: at deltaMs 0 and timerRate 0 each night's model window string must equal the retained variant's windows.model byte for byte

grid.timerRateRule: rate 0 only: the coarse grid showed uniform rate is lethal (no rate cell survives or improves) and the press-lag axis is where the surviving structure lives. deltaMs is the schedule shifted against the office clock; deltaMs -L means every press lands L ms later than its send's frame (the sched rule), toward and past the measured landing latency.

refine.rule: after the fine grid, every night refines around its own best cell: deltaMs within +-40 ms at 5 ms; rate is not refined (rateWindow 0). Cells already run are not repeated.

verdict.matchRule: a cell matches when unplayed = 0, compared >= matchMinCompared and agree = compared: every phone-read window the model played agrees
verdict.improveRule: a night improves when its best cell's agreeing windows (count) reach the control's plus ceil(improveMargin x the control's compared windows); a cell that dies early and agrees on a bare majority of the few windows it played does not improve anything
verdict.consistencyRule: matching cells across nights are consistent when every pair's deltaMs differs by at most consistentDeltaMs and every pair's timerRate by at most consistentRate; the per-night measured landing latencies (tw-12 74.8, full-04 64.7, full-06 81.6 ms) are the physical anchor a consistent peak would have to sit near
verdict.statusRule: ALIGNMENT_CELLS_FOUND if any night has a matching cell; IMPROVED_NOT_ALIGNED if none matches but some night improves; NO_PHASE_RATE_ALIGNMENT otherwise (no constant phase or uniform rate cell in this grid reproduces or approaches the phone's occupied windows on these nights)
